method_corrections: Original regular frame and beam-end air gaps were real defects and repaired; no tolerance relaxation substitutes for contact.
Fourteen pergola posts transfer load through actual paving to deck. Original direct-to-deck query omitted that intermediate layer; those parts are unchanged.
A failed finite side-ray search was not global proof of floating glass. All 788 current panes have positive finite horizontal seating area and exactly coincident opposed horizontal surfaces.
Six F5 colonnade caps were coplanar with F6 paving in v1. Current actual caps sit inside deck with positive deck overlap and 0.279998779296875 m paving clearance.
Malformed finite-request guards were corrected in separately frozen checker v2, preserving v1 checker/FAIL records. Geometry thresholds were not loosened.

delivery_transfer.required_supplement_transfer: The registrar independently validates each supplement and each protected actual decoded part. The generated prebrowser summary and model metadata carry the exact transfer record; this ledger is not a replacement for that gate.
delivery_transfer.temporary_decoded_arrays: Actual per-role arrays were deleted after audit as explicitly recorded by four immutable chunk-retention manifests. Hash/byte manifests and finite reports remain public; no missing array is represented as delivered.
